subject: Aligning next steps: 90-min ML/Infra immersion and attendee roster
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.z@verbify.ai>, Tom Park <tom.park@verbify.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning next steps: 90-min ML/Infra immersion and attendee roster

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Outcome: Verbify is targeting a proof-of-concept focused on latency-sensitive chat and private deployments.
- Key constraints you called out: strict VPC/KMS needs, ~5ms p50 target for short-turnaround queries, and data residency in us-west.

Next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute ML/Infra immersion where our serving engineers walk through:
  * architecture assumptions (KV cache, batching, fallbacks)
  * a short live demo using a representative prompt set
  * migration/ops checklist and bandwidth estimates

Can you confirm attendee roles on your side? From ours we'd include:
- Jordan Blake (you) — lead sales/solution
- Grace O'Connor — platform/ops engineer
- Karthik Iyer — inference/runtime engineer

I attached a short precall summary of the discovery notes and the baseline agenda so you can iterate. Please reply with two preferred 90-minute windows next week (we can tighten to 60 if you prefer) and any other stakeholders to include.

[Attachment: precall_notes.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Claire Zhang <claire.z@verbify.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps: 90-min ML/Infra immersion and attendee roster

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. Tom and I reviewed internally. We're very interested in the immersion; the VPC/KMS and latency pieces are high priority. A few notes:

- Could you make sure there's time to cover our current inference setup (we're on GCP with NVidia A10s) so we can map gaps?
- We may include our security engineer for the KMS discussion — I'll confirm but likely yes.

Availability (PT):
- Tue 2027-08-24: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 2027-08-25: 10:30–12:00 or 15:00–16:30

Either of those slots could work for a 90-minute block. If you can share a proposed attendee list and an agenda draft I can lock the security engineer.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Zhang | Head of Platform
Verbify, Inc.
claire.z@verbify.ai | +1 650-555-2468
[Attachment: verbify-discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Claire — makes sense. Including Grace and Karthik from our side to cover infra and runtime tuning.

Proposed 90-minute options (PT) — pick one:
1) Tue 2027-08-24, 14:00–15:30 (we'll do 90 but if you'd prefer shorter we can compress)
2) Wed 2027-08-25, 10:30–12:00

Proposed attendee roster (Redwood / Verbify):
- Jordan Blake — Solutions (host)
- Grace O'Connor — Platform / Ops (runbook + deployment)
- Karthik Iyer — Inference runtime (performance knobs / quantization)
- Claire Zhang — Platform lead (Verbify)
- Tom Park — Engineering manager (Verbify)
- (TBD) Security engineer — KMS discussion

Draft agenda (90 min):
- 00:00–00:10 — Intros & goals (Jordan)
- 00:10–00:30 — Current state and constraints (Verbify — Tom/Claire)
- 00:30–00:55 — Redwood serving architecture + live demo (Grace + Karthik)
- 00:55–01:10 — Quantization/latency tuning + tradeoffs (Karthik)
- 01:10–01:25 — Security/KMS and deployment model (Grace)
- 01:25–01:30 — Actions / next steps / owner assign

I've attached an agenda draft (Markdown) and re-attached the precall notes. If you confirm slot 1 or 2 I'll send a calendar invite and a small prep doc for your security engineer.
